prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot hand-painted illustrated 2D side-scrolling game sprite art. Muted blue-gray stone, moss green, warm wood/soil and restrained amber/cyan magical accents. Crisp readable full silhouettes and soft painterly local material shading; not pixel art, photoreal or 3D. ONE SQUARE transparent PNG atlas in EXACTLY TWO EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS, four equal square cells. Each cell contains one complete named object/state with generous transparent margin at least12% on every side. Fixed side-on orthographic game camera, no floor, perspective groundplane, scenery, characters, UI, arrows, labels, text, gridlines, shadows, border, glow cloud or vignette. Genuine alpha-zero outside solid objects and tightly bounded requested local light. Don't let artwork cross a cell boundary. Consistent scale, alignment, base level, object geometry and pivot between states. Falling platform art, four static state proposals of one short old blue-gray stone ledge with sparse moss and a small root underneath. Reading order: upper-left intact stable ledge; upper-right SAME ledge with clear warning cracks; lower-left SAME ledge split into three closely separated chunks with small dust-free gaps; lower-right its few separated fallen chunks, each bounded within cell. Keep intact/firstthree ledge top surface horizontal at local35%cellheight with identical width and scale; fragments remain near the same anchor with room below, never clip. Side elevation only, no visible perspective top slab. No motion trails, support chains or hazard spikes. These are four art states, not a complete falling animation.
